'''Soulless armoured zombies''' may occasionally appear near the [[chaotic rift]] north of [[Draynor Village]] during the [[2018 Halloween event]]. They will emerge from the ground, summoned by the [[soulless necromancer]], and will encircle and attack the surrounding [[Pillar (2018 Halloween event)|pillars]], pushing away any players adjacent to them. Despite having an attack option, they cannot be attacked directly.

Attempting to attack them results in the below message appearing:

{{RSFont|colour=#AE0000|bg=no|It appears your attack does not affect this enemy. Try using the soul rift near Death instead.}}

To stop them, the player must siphon souls from [[Death's soul rift]] to make the soulless necromancer mortal.
